 Here are the updated ACC power rankings following Week 8. By Patrick Previty | Oct 26, 2026, 7:00 AM EDT Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Oct 24, 2026; Miami Gardens, Florida, USA; Miami Hurricanes running back Jordan Lyle (2) runs with the football against the Pittsburgh Panthers during the fourth quarter at Hard Rock Stadium.
